shared_elements: horizontal band across the lower body
justification: Both are weathered stone works showing an anthropomorphic figure with a covering over the head, curved band across the torso area, and roundel/disc motifs rendered in shallow relief. But A is a flat rectangular plaque organised into dense columnar blocks of small sign-like units flanking a finely detailed profile figure, whereas B is a massive freestanding three-dimensional block-form body whose few motifs are broad, sparse and softly modelled — the compositional logic and the scale of detail are entirely different.
